method: Same frozen baseline entry for every alternative exit; independent counterfactual events, NOT a portfolio. No parameter or per-stock winner selection.
limits: Past periods already examined; diagnostics are not predictive probabilities
Intraday exit-day range excluded; excursions/touch timing are conservative lower bounds
20 valid symbol bars after exit; incomplete followups censored, never classified as failures
Regime at signal fixed; later changes are descriptive, never switch an existing holding automatically
Equal-entry counterfactuals may overlap and are not portfolio returns
Existing survivorship, daily bar, adjusted price and execution limits persist
